verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א גֵּ֣יא חִזָּי֑וֹן מַה־ לָּ֣ךְ אֵפ֔וֹא כִּֽי־ עָלִ֥ית כֻּלָּ֖ךְ לַגַּגּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: maś·śā gê ḥiz·zā·yō·wn mah- lāḵ ’ê·p̄ō·w kî- ‘ā·lîṯ kul·lāḵ lag·gag·gō·wṯ
verses.literal: This is the burden against the Valley of Vision What ails you now that you have all gone up to the rooftops
verses.literalPt: PESO do vale da visão. Que tens agora, pois que com todos os teus subiste aos telhados?

verses.original: תְּשֻׁא֣וֹת׀ מְלֵאָ֗ה עִ֚יר הֽוֹמִיָּ֔ה קִרְיָ֖ה עַלִּיזָ֑ה חֲלָלַ֙יִךְ֙ לֹ֣א חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֔רֶב וְלֹ֖א מֵתֵ֥י מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tə·šu·’ō·wṯ mə·lê·’āh ‘îr hō·w·mî·yāh qir·yāh ‘al·lî·zāh ḥă·lā·la·yiḵ lō ḥal·lê- ḥe·reḇ wə·lō mê·ṯê mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: O city of commotion . . . O town of revelry Your slain did not die by the sword nor were they killed in battle
verses.literalPt: Tu, cheia de clamores, cidade turbulenta, cidade alegre, os teus mortos não foram mortos à espada, nem morreram na guerra.

verses.original: כָּל־ קְצִינַ֥יִךְ נָֽדְדוּ־ יַ֖חַד מִקֶּ֣שֶׁת אֻסָּ֑רוּ כָּל־ נִמְצָאַ֙יִךְ֙ אֻסְּר֣וּ יַחְדָּ֔ו מֵרָח֖וֹק בָּרָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- qə·ṣî·na·yiḵ nā·ḏə·ḏū- ya·ḥaḏ miq·qe·šeṯ ’us·sā·rū kāl- nim·ṣā·’a·yiḵ ’us·sə·rū yaḥ·dāw mê·rā·ḥō·wq bā·rā·ḥū
verses.literal: All your rulers have fled together captured without a bow All your fugitives were captured together having fled to a distant place
verses.literalPt: Todos os teus governadores juntamente fugiram, foram atados pelos arqueiros; todos os que em ti se acharam, foram amarrados juntamente, e fugiram para longe.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֥ן אָמַ֛רְתִּי שְׁע֥וּ מִנִּ֖י אֲמָרֵ֣ר בַּבֶּ֑כִי אַל־ תָּאִ֣יצוּ לְנַֽחֲמֵ֔נִי עַל־ שֹׁ֖ד בַּת־ עַמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ’ā·mar·tî šə·‘ū min·nî ’ă·mā·rêr bab·be·ḵî ’al- tā·’î·ṣū lə·na·ḥă·mê·nî ‘al- šōḏ baṯ- ‘am·mî
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I said Turn away from me let me weep bitterly Do not try to console me over the destruction of the daughter of my people
verses.literalPt: Portanto digo: Desviai de mim a vista, e chorarei amargamente; não vos canseis mais em consolar-me pela destruição da filha do meu povo.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יוֹם֩ מְהוּמָ֨ה וּמְבוּסָ֜ה וּמְבוּכָ֗ה לַֽאדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּגֵ֣יא חִזָּי֑וֹן מְקַרְקַ֥ר קִ֖ר וְשׁ֥וֹעַ אֶל־ הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kî yō·wm mə·hū·māh ū·mə·ḇū·sāh ū·mə·ḇū·ḵāh la·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ bə·ḡê ḥiz·zā·yō·wn mə·qar·qar qir wə·šō·w·a‘ ’el- hā·hār
verses.literal: For the Lord GOD of Hosts has set a day of tumult and trampling and confusion in the Valley of Vision of breaking down the walls and crying to the mountains
verses.literalPt: Porque dia de alvoroço, e de atropelamento, e de confusão é este da parte do Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos, no vale da visão; dia de derrubar o muro e de clamar até aos montes.

verses.original: וְעֵילָם֙ נָשָׂ֣א אַשְׁפָּ֔ה בְּרֶ֥כֶב אָדָ֖ם פָּֽרָשִׁ֑ים וְקִ֥יר עֵרָ֖ה מָגֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ê·lām nā·śā ’aš·pāh bə·re·ḵeḇ ’ā·ḏām pā·rā·šîm wə·qîr ‘ê·rāh mā·ḡên
verses.literal: Elam takes up a quiver with chariots . . . and horsemen and Kir uncovers the shield
verses.literalPt: Porque Elão tomou a aljava, juntamente com carros de homens e cavaleiros; e Quir descobriu os escudos.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י מִבְחַר־ עֲמָקַ֖יִךְ מָ֣לְאוּ רָ֑כֶב וְהַפָּ֣רָשִׁ֔ים שֹׁ֖ת שָׁ֥תוּ הַשָּֽׁעְרָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miḇ·ḥar- ‘ă·mā·qa·yiḵ mā·lə·’ū rā·ḵeḇ wə·hap·pā·rā·šîm šōṯ šā·ṯū haš·šā·‘ə·rāh
verses.literal: Your choicest valleys are full of chariots and horsemen are posted . . . at the gates
verses.literalPt: E os teus mais formosos vales se encherão de carros, e os cavaleiros se colocarão em ordem às portas.

verses.original: וַיְגַ֕ל אֵ֖ת מָסַ֣ךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַתַּבֵּט֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אֶל־ נֶ֖שֶׁק בֵּ֥ית הַיָּֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḡal ’êṯ mā·saḵ yə·hū·ḏāh wat·tab·bêṭ bay·yō·wm ha·hū ’el- ne·šeq bêṯ hay·yā·‘ar
verses.literal: He has uncovered the defenses of Judah On that day you looked to the weapons in the House of the Forest
verses.literalPt: E ele tirou a coberta de Judá, e naquele dia olhaste para as armas da casa do bosque.

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת בְּקִיעֵ֧י עִיר־ דָּוִ֛ד רְאִיתֶ֖ם כִּי־ רָ֑בּוּ וַֽתְּקַבְּצ֔וּ אֶת־ מֵ֥י הַבְּרֵכָ֖ה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ bə·qî·‘ê ‘îr- dā·wiḏ rə·’î·ṯem kî- rāb·bū wat·tə·qab·bə·ṣū ’eṯ- mê hab·bə·rê·ḵāh hat·taḥ·tō·w·nāh
verses.literal: You saw that there were many breaches in the walls of the City of David You collected water from the lower pool
verses.literalPt: E vistes as brechas da cidade de Davi, porquanto já eram muitas, e ajuntastes as águas do tanque de baixo.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ בָּתֵּ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם סְפַרְתֶּ֑ם וַתִּתְֿצוּ֙ הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים לְבַצֵּ֖ר הַחוֹמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- bāt·tê yə·rū·šā·lim sə·p̄ar·tem wat·tiṯ·ṣū hab·bāt·tîm lə·ḇaṣ·ṣêr ha·ḥō·w·māh
verses.literal: You counted the houses of Jerusalem and tore them down . . . to strengthen the wall
verses.literalPt: Também contastes as casas de Jerusalém, e derrubastes as casas, para fortalecer os muros.

verses.original: וּמִקְוָ֣ה׀ עֲשִׂיתֶ֗ם בֵּ֚ין הַחֹ֣מֹתַ֔יִם לְמֵ֖י הַבְּרֵכָ֣ה הַיְשָׁנָ֑ה וְלֹ֤א הִבַּטְתֶּם֙ אֶל־ עֹשֶׂ֔יהָ וְיֹצְרָ֥הּ מֵֽרָח֖וֹק לֹ֥א רְאִיתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miq·wāh ‘ă·śî·ṯem bên ha·ḥō·mō·ṯa·yim lə·mê hab·bə·rê·ḵāh hay·šā·nāh wə·lō hib·baṭ·tem ’el- ‘ō·śe·hā wə·yō·ṣə·rāh mê·rā·ḥō·wq lō rə·’î·ṯem
verses.literal: You built a reservoir between the walls for the waters of the ancient pool but you did not look to the One who made it or consider Him who planned it long ago . . .
verses.literalPt: Fizestes também um reservatório entre os dois muros para as águas do tanque velho, porém não olhastes acima, para aquele que isto tinha feito, nem considerastes o que o formou desde a antiguidade.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא לִבְכִי֙ וּלְמִסְפֵּ֔ד וּלְקָרְחָ֖ה וְלַחֲגֹ֥ר שָֽׂק׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ bay·yō·wm ha·hū liḇ·ḵî ū·lə·mis·pêḏ ū·lə·qā·rə·ḥāh wə·la·ḥă·ḡōr śāq
verses.literal: On that day the Lord GOD of Hosts called for weeping and wailing for shaven heads and the wearing of sackcloth
verses.literalPt: E o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos, chamou naquele dia para chorar e para prantear, e para raspar a cabeça, e cingir com o cilício.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ שָׂשׂ֣וֹן וְשִׂמְחָ֗ה הָרֹ֤ג׀ בָּקָר֙ וְשָׁחֹ֣ט צֹ֔אן אָכֹ֥ל בָּשָׂ֖ר וְשָׁת֣וֹת יָ֑יִן אָכ֣וֹל וְשָׁת֔וֹ כִּ֥י מָחָ֖ר נָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh śā·śō·wn wə·śim·ḥāh hā·rōḡ bā·qār wə·šā·ḥōṭ ṣōn ’ā·ḵōl bā·śār wə·šā·ṯō·wṯ yā·yin ’ā·ḵō·wl wə·šā·ṯōw kî mā·ḥār nā·mūṯ
verses.literal: But look there is joy and gladness butchering of cattle and slaughtering of sheep eating of meat and drinking of wine Let us eat and drink for tomorrow we die
verses.literalPt: Porém eis aqui gozo e alegria, matam-se bois e degolam-se ovelhas, come-se carne, e bebe-se vinho, e diz-se: Comamos e bebamos, porque amanhã morreremos.

verses.original: וְנִגְלָ֥ה בְאָזְנָ֖י יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אִם־ יְ֠כֻפַּר הֶעָוֺ֨ן הַזֶּ֤ה לָכֶם֙ עַד־ תְּמֻת֔וּן אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·niḡ·lāh ḇə·’ā·zə·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’im- yə·ḵup·par he·‘ā·wōn haz·zeh lā·ḵem ‘aḏ- tə·mu·ṯūn ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts has revealed in my hearing Until your dying day this sin of yours will never be atoned for says the Lord GOD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: Mas o SENHOR dos Exércitos revelou-se aos meus ouvidos, dizendo: Certamente esta maldade não vos será expiada até que morrais, diz o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָא֑וֹת לֶךְ־ בֹּא֙ אֶל־ הַסֹּכֵ֣ן הַזֶּ֔ה עַל־ שֶׁבְנָ֖א אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ leḵ- bō ’el- has·sō·ḵên haz·zeh ‘al- šeḇ·nā ’ă·šer ‘al- hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD of Hosts says Go say to Shebna the steward - in charge of the palace
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos: Anda e vai ter com este tesoureiro, com Sebna, o mordomo, e dize-lhe:

verses.original: מַה־ לְּךָ֥ פֹה֙ וּמִ֣י לְךָ֣ פֹ֔ה כִּֽי־ חָצַ֧בְתָּ לְּךָ֛ פֹּ֖ה קָ֑בֶר חֹצְבִ֤י מָרוֹם֙ קִבְר֔וֹ חֹקְקִ֥י בַסֶּ֖לַע מִשְׁכָּ֥ן לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- lə·ḵā p̄ōh ū·mî lə·ḵā p̄ōh kî- ḥā·ṣaḇ·tā lə·ḵā pōh qā·ḇer ḥō·ṣə·ḇî mā·rō·wm qiḇ·rōw ḥō·qə·qî ḇas·se·la‘ miš·kān lōw
verses.literal: What are you doing here and who authorized you . . . to carve out a tomb for yourself here to chisel your tomb in the height and cut your resting place in the rock
verses.literalPt: Que é que tens aqui, ou a quem tens tu aqui, para que cavasses aqui uma sepultura? Cavando em lugar alto a sua sepultura, e cinzelando na rocha uma morada para ti mesmo?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ מְטַלְטֶלְךָ֔ טַלְטֵלָ֖ה גָּ֑בֶר וְעֹטְךָ֖ עָטֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh Yah·weh mə·ṭal·ṭel·ḵā ṭal·ṭê·lāh gā·ḇer wə·‘ō·ṭə·ḵā ‘ā·ṭōh
verses.literal: Look O mighty man The LORD is about to shake you violently . . . He will take hold of you
verses.literalPt: Eis que o SENHOR te arrojará violentamente como um homem forte, e de todo te envolverá.

verses.original: צָנ֤וֹף יִצְנָפְךָ֙ צְנֵפָ֔ה כַּדּ֕וּר אֶל־ אֶ֖רֶץ רַחֲבַ֣ת יָדָ֑יִם שָׁ֣מָּה תָמ֗וּת וְשָׁ֙מָּה֙ מַרְכְּב֣וֹת כְּבוֹדֶ֔ךָ קְל֖וֹן בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣā·nō·wp̄ yiṣ·nā·p̄ə·ḵā ṣə·nê·p̄āh kad·dūr ’el- ’e·reṣ ra·ḥă·ḇaṯ yā·ḏā·yim šām·māh ṯā·mūṯ wə·šām·māh mar·kə·ḇō·wṯ kə·ḇō·w·ḏe·ḵā qə·lō·wn bêṯ ’ă·ḏō·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: roll you . . . . . . into a ball and sling you into a wide . . . land There you will die and there your glorious chariots will remain a disgrace to the house of your master
verses.literalPt: Certamente com violência te fará rolar, como se faz rolar uma bola num país espaçoso; ali morrerás, e ali acabarão os carros da tua glória, ó opróbrio da casa do teu SENHOR.

verses.original: וַהֲדַפְתִּ֖יךָ מִמַּצָּבֶ֑ךָ וּמִמַּעֲמָֽדְךָ֖ יֶהֶרְסֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·ḏap̄·tî·ḵā mim·maṣ·ṣā·ḇe·ḵā ū·mim·ma·‘ă·mā·ḏə·ḵā ye·her·se·ḵā
verses.literal: I will remove you from office and you will be ousted from your position
verses.literalPt: E demitir-te-ei do teu posto, e te arrancarei do teu assento.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וְקָרָ֣אתִי לְעַבְדִּ֔י לְאֶלְיָקִ֖ים בֶּן־ חִלְקִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū wə·qā·rā·ṯî lə·‘aḇ·dî lə·’el·yā·qîm ben- ḥil·qî·yā·hū
verses.literal: On that day I will summon My servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah
verses.literalPt: E será naquele dia que chamarei a meu servo Eliaquim, filho de Hilquias;

verses.original: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתִּ֣יו כֻּתָּנְתֶּ֗ךָ וְאַבְנֵֽטְךָ֙ אֲחַזְּקֶ֔נּוּ וּמֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ֖ אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּיָד֑וֹ וְהָיָ֥ה לְאָ֛ב לְיוֹשֵׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּלְבֵ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hil·baš·tîw kut·tā·nə·te·ḵā wə·’aḇ·nê·ṭə·ḵā ’ă·ḥaz·zə·qen·nū ū·mɛm·šɛl·tə·ḵå̄ ’et·tên bə·yā·ḏōw wə·hā·yāh lə·’āḇ lə·yō·wō·šêḇ yə·rū·šā·lim ū·lə·ḇêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: I will clothe him with your robe and tie your sash around him I will put your authority in his hand and he will be a father to the dwellers of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah
verses.literalPt: E vesti-lo-ei da tua túnica, e cingi-lo-ei com o teu cinto, e entregarei nas suas mãos o teu domínio, e será como pai para os moradores de Jerusalém, e para a casa de Judá.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֛י מַפְתֵּ֥חַ בֵּית־ דָּוִ֖ד עַל־ שִׁכְמ֑וֹ וּפָתַח֙ וְאֵ֣ין סֹגֵ֔ר וְסָגַ֖ר וְאֵ֥ין פֹּתֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî map̄·tê·aḥ bêṯ- dā·wiḏ ‘al- šiḵ·mōw ū·p̄ā·ṯaḥ wə·’ên sō·ḡêr wə·sā·ḡar wə·’ên pō·ṯê·aḥ
verses.literal: I will place on his shoulder the key to the house of David What he opens no one can shut and what he shuts no one can open
verses.literalPt: E porei a chave da casa de Davi sobre o seu ombro, e abrirá, e ninguém fechará; e fechará, e ninguém abrirá.

verses.original: וּתְקַעְתִּ֥יו יָתֵ֖ד בְּמָק֣וֹם נֶאֱמָ֑ן וְהָיָ֛ה לְכִסֵּ֥א כָב֖וֹד לְבֵ֥ית אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṯə·qa‘·tîw yā·ṯêḏ bə·mā·qō·wm ne·’ĕ·mān wə·hā·yāh lə·ḵis·sê ḵā·ḇō·wḏ lə·ḇêṯ ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: I will drive him like a peg into a firm place and he will be a throne of glory for the house of his father
verses.literalPt: E fixá-lo-ei como a um prego num lugar firme, e será como um trono de honra para a casa de seu pai.

verses.original: וְתָל֨וּ עָלָ֜יו כֹּ֣ל׀ כְּב֣וֹד בֵּית־ אָבִ֗יו הַצֶּֽאֱצָאִים֙ וְהַצְּפִע֔וֹת כֹּ֖ל כְּלֵ֣י הַקָּטָ֑ן מִכְּלֵי֙ הָֽאַגָּנ֔וֹת וְעַ֖ד כָּל־ כְּלֵ֥י הַנְּבָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯā·lū ‘ā·lāw kōl kə·ḇō·wḏ bêṯ- ’ā·ḇîw haṣ·ṣe·’ĕ·ṣā·’îm wə·haṣ·ṣə·p̄i·‘ō·wṯ kōl kə·lê haq·qā·ṭān mik·kə·lê hā·’ag·gā·nō·wṯ wə·‘aḏ kāl- kə·lê han·nə·ḇā·lîm
verses.literal: So they will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house the descendants and the offshoots all the lesser . . . vessels from bowls to every kind . . . of jar
verses.literalPt: E nele pendurarão toda a honra da casa de seu pai, a prole e os descendentes, como também todos os vasos menores, desde as taças até os frascos.

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת תָּמוּשׁ֙ הַיָּתֵ֔ד הַתְּקוּעָ֖ה בְּמָק֣וֹם נֶאֱמָ֑ן וְנִגְדְּעָ֣ה וְנָפְלָ֗ה וְנִכְרַת֙ הַמַּשָּׂ֣א אֲשֶׁר־ עָלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ tā·mūš hay·yā·ṯêḏ hat·tə·qū·‘āh bə·mā·qō·wm ne·’ĕ·mān wə·niḡ·də·‘āh wə·nā·p̄ə·lāh wə·niḵ·raṯ ham·maś·śā ’ă·šer- ‘ā·le·hā kî Yah·weh dib·bêr
verses.literal: In that day declares the LORD of Hosts the peg driven into a firm place will give way it will be sheared off and fall and the load upon it will be cut down Indeed the LORD has spoken
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, o prego fincado em lugar firme será tirado; e será cortado, e cairá, e a carga que nele estava se desprenderá, porque o SENHOR o disse.
